notes.title: Bug fix(ver 1.0.7)
notes.content:
Fixed an issue that caused some keychains to not function.
Fixed an issue that allowed additional board generation to be performed even during an NPC's turn.
Prevented score overflow.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed bias in random numbers.
Improved the appearance frequency of items that had extremely low appearance rates.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the inventory would not update if the number of stones in the deck reached a certain value.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the keychain would not activate properly
Fixed a bug in the inventory animation

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where eye and mouth effects would not activate in endless mode.
Fixed an issue where items would remain in the shop.

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: Fixed an issue where using Ghost Stone would cause the game to freeze.
